notes: «وشكا هشام بن إبراهيم إلى أبي الحسن الرضا»: the one who complains transmits the answer, and the Imam he complains to is the last link (rule 5, owner ruling 2)

from «قال فَفَعَلْتُ» the account is Hisham's first person, then «قال محمد بن راشد وكنت دائم العلة» gives a second first-person speaker with no written transmission to the compiler: a first-person narrative with implicit transmission (rule 11), so the chain is not extended
